Input: 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs — Dasatinib (CLint=220, fu_plasma=0.04), Bosutinib (CLint=60, fu_plasma=0.03), Imatinib (CLint=25, fu_plasma=0.04), Nilotinib (CLint=12, fu_plasma=0.01); model parameters: Qh=20.7 mL/min/kg, fu_mic=1.0
Key steps:

PKNCA scaler → fu_plasma + fu_mic correction applied to each CLint → scaled whole-liver CLint (mL/min/kg)
Well-stirred model → CLh = (Qh × fu_plasma × CLint_scaled) / (Qh + fu_plasma × CLint_scaled) → per-compound CLh (mL/min/kg)
Extraction ratio calculator → EH = CLh / Qh → tier classification (low <0.3 / medium 0.3–0.7 / high >0.7)


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh + EH per compound with model parameters) + clearance_summary.json (extraction tier flags and inter-compound ranking for the 4 TKIs)
